sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We deeply appreciate your trust and the successful twelve-year partnership between our companies. Our family foundry has always valued working alongside Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

We are pleased to support your planning by accepting the 24-month contract term, though we must propose a compromise of 45 days for the payment terms. On this basis, we can offer a revised price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €52.00 per unit, a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our collaboration.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: We have never played your foundry against others, and we do not want to start. Loyalty has been our side of this relationship; we ask for yours on the price.

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We deeply value our twelve-year partnership and the loyalty that has defined our collaboration.
We cannot accept a regressive move and must therefore maintain our offer of €52.20 for the 60-day payment term.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your intention to continue our twelve-year partnership, a sentiment we share deeply. Over these many years, our foundry has always taken great pride in delivering the highest quality to your company. 

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We must firmly maintain our offer of €52.20 for the 60-day payment term and 24-month contract. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. For your planning, our offer consists of a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long standing relationship very much and look forward to continuing our work together in the future.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
